deadline.value: International Fall 2027 application deadline is May 1, 2027 (document submissions due June 1).

also.quote: International Application Deadlines | Fall | Application | Document Submissions | May 1 | June 1

gre_general.value: A GRE score is not required for applicants to the Ph.D. in Computer Science.
gre_general.quote: In addition, a GRE score is not required for applicants to the Ph.D. in Computer Science.

toefl_min.value: College of Engineering graduate programs (Master's and Ph.D.) require a minimum TOEFL score of 4.0 on the new 2026 scale (79 iBT on the prior scale).

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Computer Science.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-admission supervisor agreement is not required prior to applying, though faculty availability to supervise the applicant's research influences the admission decision.

funding.value: Competitive Graduate Teaching and Research Assistantships (full-time 20 hr/week or part-time 10 hr/week) pay a monthly stipend plus tuition and some fees; Ph.D. applicants are strongly encouraged to apply via the CS Assistantship portal after admission.
funding.quote: Pays a monthly stipend (prorated for part-time positions) | Pays tuition and some fees (prorated for part-time positions) | Monthly stipends are competitive, and PhD applicants are strongly encouraged to apply.

entry_route.value: General requirement is an appropriate Master's degree (MS GPA >= 3.5), though exceptional applicants with a bachelor's degree in a computer science-related program may be admitted directly.
entry_route.quote: Though the general requirement for admission to the Ph.D. program is a Master's degree in an appropriate discipline, students with a bachelor's degree may be admitted to the Ph.D. program directly on exceptional basis

notes: Standalone Ph.D. in Computer Science housed in the College of Engineering. Teaching assistantships cover 9 months (no summer stipend), while research assistantships may cover 12 months.
name: Computer Science, Ph.D.
